identity.title: Reconstructing the EUV Spectrum of Star-forming Regions from Millimeter Recombination Lines of H I, He I, and He II

paper_type_evidence.quote: Here we present a study based on ALMA observations of three Galactic ultra-compact HII regions and the starburst region Sgr B2(M), in which we reconstruct the key parameters of the EUV spectra

question.value: Can the EUV spectrum (13.6-54.4 eV slope and above) of star-forming regions be reconstructed from mm recombination lines H30a, He30a and He+48a, and does it agree with Starburst99 and BPASS models?

evidence.quote: We compare the inferred values of the EUV spectral slopes with the values expected for a purely single stellar evolution model (Starburst99) and the Binary Population and Spectral Synthesis code (BPASS).
Our data were obtained during two ALMA observational programs: Cycle 2 project 2013.1.00111.S and Cycle 4 project 2016.1.01015.S.

analysis_steps.goal: Extract spectra and fit recombination lines

method.value: Spectra from sub-regions and tot_H30a region; fit Gaussian/Voigt profiles to get V, DeltaV and integrated flux, excluding molecular lines; HI fitted first and subtracted when HeI sits on its wing

evidence.quote: we fitted the spectra with a combination of Gaussian and Voigt profiles and then used the fit to extract central velocity ($V$) of the H30$\alpha$ and He30$\alpha$ lines
we fitted the spectra with a combination of Gaussian and Voigt profiles

method.value: Assume V and width equal to He30a and fit the expected profile to uncontaminated data points

evidence.quote: we use the width and the velocity of He30$\alpha$ lines to obtain the expected He$^+$48$\alpha$ profile which we then fit under the uncontaminated spectral data points
we assume that $V_\mathrm{He^+48\alpha } = V_\mathrm{H30\alpha } \simeq V_\mathrm{He30\alpha }$ and $\Delta V_\mathrm{He^+48\alpha } = \Delta V_\mathrm{He30\alpha }.$

analysis_steps.goal: Derive EM, Q and EUV slopes

method.value: Convert line fluxes to emission measures (eq. SdVtoEM), then to Q0,Q1,Q2 via recombination coefficients, then solve for gamma, L0, gamma_2 of a broken power law

evidence.quote: Using eq. [\[a\]] we can solve for $\gamma$, which we then substitute it into the rest of the equations to find $L_0, \, L_2$ and $\gamma_2,$

assumptions.value: Radiation equilibrium, no EUV photon escape, no photon stealing by lower-threshold species; T=1e4 K

evidence.quote: we assume (i) that the gas is in a radiation equilibrium, so that the number of recombinations of each ion species is equal to the number of ionizations

validation.value: Error propagation: ~4% on gamma for Cycle 4, ~10% Sgr B2(M); ~20% true uncertainty due to approximate equations

evidence.quote: Since the equations are approximate, we expect the true uncertainties on the derived spectral parameters to be $\sim 20 \%.$

findings_qualitative.value: All four regions show similar EUV slopes irrespective of evolutionary stage; HeII recombination line not detected in any target.

evidence.quote: The HeII recombination line was not detected in any of our targets.

claims.hypothesis: mm H/He recombination lines can reconstruct EUV spectral slopes
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 6 observations of H30a, He30a, He+48a in four HII regions

evidence.quote: We find that in all cases the EUV spectra between 13.6 and 54.4 eV have similar frequency dependence

claims.hypothesis: Observed slopes match Starburst99 and BPASS
claims.experiment: Compare gamma with model slopes vs age
claims.result: Observed slopes steeper than ~3 for <7 Myr; between models for older ages
claims.finding: Observations differ from models; binary fraction possibly lower than in BPASS

evidence.quote: This may imply that the fraction of interacting binaries in HII regions is substantially lower than assumed in BPASS.

claims.finding: Metallicity alone cannot account for it

evidence.quote: the metallicity alone cannot account for the discrepancy of the model and the observed spectral properties

why_this_data.value: Lines chosen to be observable simultaneously in ALMA Band 6 and avoid molecular line confusion

evidence.quote: H30$\alpha ,$ He30$\alpha ,$ and He$^+48\alpha$ lines can be observed simultaneously with ALMA Band 6 making them our preferred choice.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Ages of all regions being the same (~2.5 Myr) was ruled out

evidence.quote: We rule out this possibility.

limitations_admitted.value: Molecular line contamination dominates flux accuracy; G328.8076 slope unreliable; ages unknown; photon escape in evolved regions

evidence.quote: The accuracy of determining $[S\Delta V],$ $V$ and $\Delta V$ is dominated by molecular lines contamination, which is hard to quantify.

referee_caveats_inferred: Sub-regions of the same HII region treated as independent probes
Slope uncertainty dominated by model assumptions, not propagated statistically
Dust absorption of EUV photons and photon stealing neglected
Only three sources give reliable slopes; age unknown so model comparison is ambiguous
